Shanghai Municipal Council.
September 15th 1917
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Sir,
E.Josephi, No.13 Fearon Road made a report
to Police Headquarters on the afternoon of September
14th to the effect that the wife of Ettinger of Nanzing
Road has been making enquiries as to where she can
purchase black hair dye and Josephi surmises in
consequence that Ettinger is going to clear out and
that his wife is making arrangements to change his
hair from red to black in order to render the work
of identification difficult if he is sought
for by the Police.
Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
i/c C.I.D.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1917年9月15日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
先生：
费伦路（Fearon Road）13号的E. Josephi于9月14日下午向警察总局报告称，南京路Ettinger的妻子一直在打听何处可以购买黑色染发剂，Josephi据此推测Ettinger打算潜逃，其妻子正安排将他的头发由红色染成黑色，以便在警方通缉时增加身份识别的难度。
您忠实的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）
刑侦处处长
警司
